areas: Seattle, the Pacific Northwest, and the San Francisco Bay Area

hero.sub: Every light in the house on keypads, scenes, and schedules. Designed and installed by our team for new construction and remodels.

items.p: One button sets the room: morning, dinner, movie, goodnight.
Say a scene out loud, or run the lights from your phone.
Lights follow your schedule. Shades can move with them.

about.h2: The people with your technology solutions
about.p: Qnorthwest has been at work since 2011, when our first employee joined, and is headquartered in Seattle. More than 30 of our people know Lutron's systems in depth, and we design, wire, program, and service every system we install.
about.alt: The Qnorthwest team together at a 2023 Best Workplaces event

items.p: A Masterclass in Electrical Work! From the very first interaction, Joe and his entire team set the bar high. The estimate process was clear, fair, and professional — and the execution was nothing short of exceptional.

I recently purchased my house and the inspector I hired identified significant issues with the electrical. I was referred to Qnorthwest by a colleague. Joe and Blake assessed my home’s electrical systems professionally, efficiently and thoroughly.

I used on line chat to make an appointment, it was easy and quick. The electrician - Joe came on time and diagnose the problem right away. Fortunately, it's an easy job that my husband can do it by himself.

process.h2: How we work with your project

steps.p: We work with you, the builder, or the general contractor from the first planning stages.
Our line voltage and low voltage electricians run the wire, so one crew owns the lighting.
Every scene is programmed, then the system is commissioned and tested before move-in.
The owners learn the system, and we service every system we install.

items.q: Can you add lighting control to the home I live in now?
items.a: Yes. We modernize existing homes and work alongside the technology you already have.

items.q: When should we bring you in on a new build?
items.a: At the first planning stages. We work with your builder or architect through move-in day.

items.q: Which lighting systems do you install?
items.a: Every Lutron system, including HomeWorks QSX, RadioRA 3, and Ketra, plus Vantage, Crestron, and Control4.

items.q: We have an old LiteTouch system. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. We fix, change, or upgrade older LiteTouch and other legacy systems.

items.q: Do you do the electrical work too?
items.a: Yes. Our team includes line voltage and low voltage electricians.

items.p: Every system in the house on one easy platform.
Whole home, single room, and outdoor sound.
Natural light where you want it, UV kept off art.
The movie experience at home, calibrated.
Cameras, doorbells, and alarms sized to your needs.
Strong WiFi in every room, wired with cable and fiber.

final.p: New build or remodel, a line or two is enough. We will set a time to talk.

footer.creds: Lutron Diamond Dealer. Licensed line voltage and low voltage electricians.

form.hint: A line or two is plenty: new build or remodel, and the rooms you want on keypads.
